info.name: KeylessFlow API
info.description:
KeylessFlow (Ospite) digital guest experience platform: booking and payments, check-in and room access, guest services.

## Setup
1. In `Backend/`: `npm install`, copy `.env.example` to `.env`, then `npm run seed`.
2. Start the API: `npm run dev`.
3. Check `baseUrl` below (default `http://localhost:8080/api/v1`).
4. Set `paystackSecretKey` to the same value as `PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY` in `.env` (used only to sign the simulated webhook).
5. Run the folders in order, or the whole collection with the Runner: each request saves the IDs the next one needs.

## Conventions
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Guest requests use `guestToken` (set at the collection level); staff and admin requests override it.
- Success responses: `{ success: true, data, message?, pagination? }`. Errors: `{ success: false, message, details? }`.
- References: bookings `KFB-XXXXXXXX`, payments `KFP-XXXXXXXX`, service requests `KFR-XXXXXXXX`. Guest IDs are MongoDB ObjectIds.
- Dates: `YYYY-MM-DD` for stays. Timestamps are ISO 8601 in UTC. Amounts are in Naira (Paystack receives kobo).

const start = new Date(Date.UTC(today.getUTCFullYear(), today.getUTCMonth(), today.getUTCDate()));

item.name: 01 Auth
item.description: Guest accounts (register/login) and staff accounts (seeded by `npm run seed`). Login requests store tokens in collection variables that every other request uses.

Seeded staff account. Staff can update service requests, record verification results and view guests.

item.name: 02 Rooms (Squad A)
item.description: Room catalogue and availability search. Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD`. The collection sets `checkInDate` to today and `checkOutDate` to two days later.

exec: pm.test('Has rooms (run npm run seed if empty)', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.length).to.be.above(0));

request.description: Optional filters: `type` (standard, deluxe, executive, suite), `guests`, `minPrice`, `maxPrice`.

exec: pm.test('At least two rooms are available', () => pm.expect(rooms.length).to.be.above(1));

request.description: Returns rooms free for the whole stay, with `nights` and `totalPrice`. Add `includeUnavailable=true` to also get booked rooms flagged with `isAvailable: false`.

item.name: Availability with invalid dates is rejected

request.description: Setting `isActive: false` hides a room from guests without deleting it.

item.name: 03 Bookings (Squad A)
item.description: A new booking holds the room for `BOOKING_HOLD_MINUTES` (default 30) with status `pending_payment` until payment is verified.

request.description: Guest details default to the logged-in profile. Send `guestDetails: { firstName, lastName, email, phone }` to book for someone else.

item.name: Duplicate submission returns the same booking

request.description: Guests see only their own bookings. Filters: `status`, `paymentStatus`, `from`, `to`, `page`, `limit`.
Also returns the latest payment and the check-in status. Squad B uses this to fetch a reservation.

item.name: 04 Payments (Squad A)
item.description:
Paystack payments in test mode.

**Real flow:** Initialize payment, open `authorizationUrl` in a browser, pay with a Paystack test card (4084 0840 8408 4081, CVV 408, any future expiry, PIN 0000, OTP 123456), then call Verify payment.

**Without a browser:** run *Simulate Paystack webhook*. It signs a `charge.success` event with `paystackSecretKey`, which must equal the server's `PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY`.

request.description: Creates a Paystack transaction for the booking amount. Calling it again while a payment is open returns the same `authorizationUrl`.
Call this after Paystack redirects the guest back to `PAYSTACK_CALLBACK_URL`. It asks Paystack for the result.

exec: // Builds and signs a charge.success event, as Paystack would send it
if (!secret) throw new Error('Set the paystackSecretKey collection variable to your PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY');

item.name: Webhook with a bad signature is rejected
05 Check-in (Squad B)
item.description:
Pre-arrival check-in opens `CHECKIN_WINDOW_HOURS` (default 48) before the check-in date, for confirmed and paid bookings.

**Simulated ID verification:** `nameOnId` must contain the first and last name on the booking. ID formats: `national_id` 11 digits, `passport` 6-9 letters/digits, `drivers_license` 8-15 letters/digits. Any ID number starting with `000` is rejected, to demo a failed check. Guests get 3 attempts, then staff must record the result manually.

exec: pm.test('Full ID number is not returned', () => pm.expect(JSON.stringify(c)).to.not.include('12345678901'));

request.description: Front desk override for guests who failed automated verification. Returns 409 here because the guest is already verified.

item.name: 06 Room access (Squad B)
item.description: Digital keys for verified guests. The raw token is returned once and only its hash is stored. Keys expire at `CHECKOUT_HOUR_UTC` on the check-out date. `/lock/validate` plays the role of the door lock.

exec: pm.test('Token issued for the booked room', () => pm.expect(t.roomNumber).to.eql(pm.variables.get('roomNumber')));

request.description: Issuing a new key revokes the previous one.

item.name: 07 Guest services (Squad C)
item.description: Concierge requests for confirmed or checked-in stays. Status flow: `pending` → `in_progress` → `completed` (or `cancelled`). Staff update statuses.

request.description: Categories: housekeeping, room_service, maintenance, general_assistance. Optional: `priority` (low, normal, high), `preferredTime` (ISO date-time).
Filters: `status`, `category`, `bookingReference`.
Staff see all requests. Filters: `status`, `category`, `bookingReference`, `roomNumber`.

item.name: 08 Recommendations (Squad C)
item.description: Rule-based recommendations. With `bookingReference`, they are filtered by room type, number of nights, weekend stays and stay stage (before arrival or during the stay), and each one includes the `reasons` it was picked.

request.description: Categories: dining, spa_wellness, tours, transport, amenities, events. Rule stages: any, pre_arrival, in_stay.

item.name: 09 Notifications
item.description: In-app notifications created by the system: booking confirmed, payment failed, booking reminders, check-in complete, room key issued, service request updates.

request.description: Add `unread=true` for unread only. The response includes `unreadCount`.

item.name: 10 Staff & admin
item.description: Hotel staff tools: guest lookup, bookings, abandoned-booking reminders, staff accounts and check-out.

request.description: Includes the guest's 20 most recent bookings.
Filters: `status`, `paymentStatus`, `guestId`, `reference`, `roomNumber`, `from`, `to`.

Rule-based detection: unpaid, older than `ABANDONMENT_NUDGE_AFTER_MINUTES`, not reminded yet, arrival date not passed, and the guest has not completed another booking since. `olderThanMinutes` overrides the age for demos.
Also runs automatically every `JOB_INTERVAL_MINUTES`. One reminder per guest, sent as an in-app notification with a resume link.
Roles: admin, staff. Departments: front_desk, housekeeping, room_service, maintenance, concierge, management.
Ends the stay and revokes all room keys for the booking.

item.description: A separate booking that is created and then cancelled before payment.
